entries.284a2552d7b78ab9: The company and four consolidated subsidiaries, one unconsolidated subsidiary and one affiliate make up the group, which operates membership-based sports clubs and related businesses. The reportable segment is a single segment, the Sports Club Management Business. In the United States, a consolidated subsidiary operates a membership golf club.
